datasetVersion: Repository 5.2.0 release series; country/admin1 layer contents may represent older administrative snapshots

processing.simplification: Douglas-Peucker spherical interval=2000m with keep-shapes; global countries/admin1 combined for shared topology
processing.geometryRepairs: Shapely make_valid on 6 country and 7 admin1 features, discarding degenerate line components; details in validation.json
processing.properties: Reduced to stable identifier, name, country identifier, ISO code, label position, geographic region; added bbox per feature

limitations: Modern reference outlines, not historical borders, legal/cadastral boundaries, or an up-to-the-minute administrative atlas.
2 km simplification suits region-scale research maps; some coastlines and tiny areas are generalized.
Natural Earth uses cartographic viewpoints for disputed territories; each feature is not necessarily a UN sovereign country.
Some admin1 entries are dated or include special/disputed units (for example Pakistani FATA and Syrian UNDOF).
Country/admin1 availability varies in small dependencies. Do not describe every country as having historical or present-day provinces.
